description: New in TD 2025.3: Triangulates closed line strips into surface geometry made of triangles. Two modes: Convex only (highly parallel, fast) and Convex and Concave (slower but handles complex shapes). Primarily used to surface the output of Trace POP or other line-strip generators.

parameters.name: Triangulation Mode
parameters.description: Convex Only is fast and highly parallel but only works for convex shapes. Convex and Concave handles any closed line strip but may be slower for long strips.

parameters.name: Remove Zero Area
parameters.description: New in 2025.3: Removes triangles with zero or near-zero area that can appear at degenerate input points.

parameters.name: Hole Detection
parameters.description: When enabled, detects interior holes in the triangulated surface and excludes them from the output.

useCases: Converting closed line strips to filled triangle meshes
Surfacing Trace POP output for rendering
Creating meshes from line strip outlines for LED walls
Surface generation from contour lines in scientific visualization
Filling enclosed 2D shapes for projection mapping

examples.name: Trace to Mesh
examples.description: Movie File In TOP → Trace POP (Auto) → Triangulate POP (Convex Only) → Render TOP

examples.name: Complex Shape Surfacing
examples.description: Trace POP (Threshold) → Triangulate POP (Convex and Concave) → Normal POP → Render for lit surface

examples.name: Contour Line Filling
examples.description: Line POP (closed shape) → Triangulate POP → Noise POP displacement → Render for organic surface

commonCombinations: Trace POP → Triangulate POP (line trace to filled mesh)
Triangulate POP → Normal POP (compute surface normals for lighting)
Triangulate POP → Render TOP (render triangulated surface)
Triangulate POP → Noise POP (displace triangulated surface)
Text POP (Triangles) → Triangulate POP (fill text outlines)
Triangulate POP → GLSL POP (custom surface manipulation)

troubleshooting.solution: Ensure input line strips are fully closed (last point connects to first). Switch to Convex and Concave mode for non-convex shapes.

troubleshooting.problem: Output is very slow for long line strips
troubleshooting.solution: Convex and Concave mode is slower for long strips. Try reducing the number of points with Line Resample POP first, or use Convex Only if shapes are simple.
Enable the Remove Zero Area toggle (enabled by default) to filter degenerate triangles.
Verify input contains closed line strips (not open polylines or individual points). Check that the line strip forms a valid closed loop.
